363:     @staticmethod
364:     def convert_rate(rate: int) -> int:
365:         # Rate conversion due to the fact that we had a different system with Swift
366:         # and the old python BitTorrent core: unlimited == 0, stop == -1, else rate in kbytes
367:         return {0: -1, -1: 1}.get(rate, rate * 1024)
368: 
369:     @staticmethod
370:     def reverse_convert_rate(rate: int) -> int:
371:         # Inverse of convert_rate: translate a libtorrent rate back to the Tribler rate.
372:         return {-1: 0, 1: -1}.get(rate, rate // 1024)
373: 
374:     def set_upload_rate_limit(self, rate, hops=None):
375:         libtorrent_rate = self.convert_rate(rate)
376: 
377:         # Pass outgoing_port and num_outgoing_ports to dict due to bug in libtorrent 0.16.18
378:         settings_dict = {'upload_rate_limit': libtorrent_rate, 'outgoing_port': 0, 'num_outgoing_ports': 1}
379:         for session in self.ltsessions.values():
380:             self.set_session_settings(session, settings_dict)
381: 
382:     def get_upload_rate_limit(self, hops=None):
383:         libtorrent_rate = self.get_session(hops).upload_rate_limit()
384:         return self.reverse_convert_rate(libtorrent_rate)
